summary: The candidate fixes and tests the in-bounds no-rope MLA DCP owner/local-location write and adds the two virtual-capacity adjustments, but an independent GPU case shows that its changed no-rope kernel still violates the reserved_skip_index contract on DCP rank 0. Full eight-rank H100 GLM-5.3-Flash serving, watermark crossing, sparse read/merge/gather paths, and semantic quality could not be verified on the single assigned gfx950 GPU without the model weights.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction at the recorded base: both simulated DCP ranks failed local-row numerical comparison for no-rope writes, while the rope controls passed (2 failed, 2 passed).
Candidate regression executed the changed Triton kernel on gfx950 for rope/no-rope, ranks 0/1, owner filtering, and loc//world-size localization (4 passed).
All runnable touched unit/kernel tests passed (12 passed); 58 CUDA-TMA-specific cases were skipped on ROCm.
Independent GPU boundary test: owner localization at the last physical row passed for both ranks, but the default reserved location 0 was overwritten with NaNs on DCP rank 0.

gpu_execution.evidence: Changed Triton source from /job/repo/python/sglang/kernels/ops/kvcache/mla_buffer.py was compiled with private Triton caches and executed on one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), ROCm 7.2, torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2.

remaining_counterexamples: With DCP world size 2, rank 0, no-rope input, loc=[0], and the public default reserved_skip_index=0, the candidate writes the padding row into physical slot 0; a NaN source makes the reserved slot NaN.
The candidate regression always passes reserved_skip_index=-1 and therefore does not cover its public default or parity with the rope kernel.
remaining_limitations: Only one AMD gfx950 GPU was assigned; the reported eight-H100 DCP topology and CUDA-specific kernels were unavailable.
GLM-5.3-Flash weights were unavailable, so the original long-context watermark crossing and semantic-quality degradation were not reproduced end to end.
Sparse decode/target-verify LSE merge and sparse-extend all-gather behavior were not qualified end to end.
The index-K capacity tests are construction-helper unit tests; the reported multi-request OOB crash was not reproduced without the model and eight GPUs.
No native C++ or FlyDSL files changed, so no native rebuild was applicable; 58 CUDA-TMA-specific tests were skipped on ROCm.
